title: Rockets and floating
info: A rocket flies by pushing gas backward. The rocket is pushed forward. That is action and reaction.
The International Space Station orbits Earth about every 90 minutes.
Astronauts float because they are falling around Earth together with the station. Gravity there is still strong. This is called free fall.
Space has almost no air, so sound does not travel the way it does in a classroom, and people need suits or ships with air.
